entities.summary: Jerzy Kluger was a Polish Jewish businessman who lived in Rome. He was born in 1921 in Kraków and raised in Wadowice where, as a small boy, he met and became a personal friend of Karol Wojtyła, later Archbishop of Kraków and eventually Pope John Paul II.
